Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the sources, incorrectly claiming Britannica did not list Delmer Daves as a film producer, reducing his roles to two. Britannica explicitly titles Daves as “Screenwriter, Director & Film Producer,” giving him three roles versus Phil Rosen’s two (director, cinematographer). The Planner then introduced an arbitrary “scope_index” tiebreaker to favor Rosen, leading to the wrong conclusion.
